title: Dune Allen "Lazy Days" 912 Allen Loop Drive
h1: Dune Allen "Lazy Days" 912 Allen Loop Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $35 per day.- 4 adult bikes- 6-Passenger LSV- Garage- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. DETAILS: Escape to the luxurious Emerald Coast and unwind at 912 Allen Loop Drive. With enough space to comfortably sleep 10, this 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home boasts a generous 1,859 square feet of living space with comfortable accommodations, a covered patio for entertaining, a private pool, firepit, and more. Nestled in the exclusive Dune Allen community, this private oasis offers unparalleled access to the pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters of the Gulf of Mexico—located at the end of the street!Inside the first floor of this stunning 2-story home, pristine white shiplap walls and beautiful hardwood floors are illuminated by abundant natural light. The living area exudes comfort with its plush furniture, inviting fireplace, and impressive 70" TV—perfect for cozy nights in. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight with its white marble countertops adorned with gorgeous blue cabinetry and high-end appliances. Exposed shelves add a touch of elegance while keeping everything within arm's reach. A traditional dining table comfortably seats 10, while the adjacent breakfast bar seats 2 more. The washer and dryer are conveniently located off the kitchen, leading directly to the hallway bunk room with a queen-over-queen bed and a TV for late-night cartoons. A stunning primary bedroom is also on this floor, with a luxurious king bed and private bathroom. Marvel at the covered outdoor patio from the great room, beckoning guests to breathe fresh air while sinking into the plush furniture or lazing around on the porch swing. Splash around in the 4' deep pool surrounded by loungers and soft outdoor chairs before dining alfresco with fresh food off the propane grill. Adirondack chairs around a modern firepit are perfect for after-house cocktails.Ascend to the second floor of this tranquil abode to find a relaxing oasis adorned with 2 well-appointed guest bedrooms featuring king beds, TVs, and great natural lighting from the picture windows.912 Allen Loop Drive offers an unparalleled location and impeccable amenities. With on-site parking for 5 vehicles—plus 4 complimentary adult bikes—it's easy to explore the area. For fun in the sun, head to West Allen Loop Public Access by simply following Allen Loop Drive toward West County Highway 30A. Beach access is at the end of Allen Loop Drive. Set the stage for an unforgettable vacation; book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR;-Guest Bedroom: King, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo
